skills.name: changelog-writer
skills.description: Keep a CHANGELOG file current from recent commits in the Keep a Changelog format. Use after merges.

skills.name: competitor-scan
skills.description: Scan competitor websites and public pages for changes in pricing, features, and launches. Use weekly.

skills.name: daily-briefing
skills.description: Compile the morning briefing: today's calendar, urgent mail, and open follow-ups. Use each weekday.

skills.name: dependency-audit
skills.description: List outdated and vulnerable project dependencies with upgrade risk notes. Use monthly or before a release.

skills.name: email-reply-drafts
skills.description: Draft replies to a specific email thread in the user's voice. Use when the user asks for a reply.

skills.name: invoice-chaser
skills.description: Find unpaid invoices past due and draft polite payment reminders. Use weekly or when asked to chase.

skills.name: issue-triage
skills.description: Triage new issues in a project tracker: label, deduplicate, and ask for missing details. Use daily.

skills.name: link-checker
skills.description: Check a list of URLs for broken links, redirects, and slow pages. Use before a launch or after a site change.

skills.name: meeting-notes-to-actions
skills.description: Turn meeting notes or a transcript into owners, action items, and deadlines. Use after any meeting.

skills.name: news-digest
skills.description: Build a short digest of news on the user's chosen topics from trusted sources. Use daily or on request.

skills.name: paper-summary
skills.description: Summarise a research paper with its question, method, results, and limits. Use when given a paper link or PDF.

skills.name: price-watch
skills.description: Track product prices on given pages and report drops below the user's target. Use when asked to watch a price.

skills.name: receipt-sorter
skills.description: Sort receipts from a folder or mailbox into a dated, categorised log for expense reports. Use monthly.

skills.name: release-notes
skills.description: Write release notes for a version from merged changes, grouped and checked. Use before publishing a release.

skills.name: seo-audit
skills.description: Run a basic on-page SEO audit of a site's key pages and list prioritised fixes. Use before a launch.

skills.name: spreadsheet-cleanup
skills.description: Clean a messy spreadsheet: trim spaces, fix types, dedupe, and log every change. Use on request.

skills.name: study-flashcards
skills.description: Turn study notes or a chapter into question-and-answer flashcards with spaced review dates. Use when studying.

skills.name: travel-planner
skills.description: Draft a trip itinerary with options, timings, and a checklist from the user's constraints. Use for trip planning.

skills.name: web-form-filler
skills.description: Fill in a web form from a user-provided data file, stopping before submission. Use for repetitive forms.

skills.name: weekly-status-report
skills.description: Build a weekly status report from sent mail, calendar, and workspace notes. Use on Fridays or on request.
